headline: Get Squashel
title: How to Get Squashel | The Fire Breaker | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Squashel is a Fire Breaker you get by evolving Squarrel at level forty seven. Squarrel lives in Blitzwood, spawning around levels forty to forty five, so a wild catch is already close to the evolution level. Squashel also shows up in Blitzwood, but it is rare, so evolving is the reliable way. It is the end of the line, with no other forms. Will you break bosses with Squashel? Comment below!
description: Aniimo's Squashel evolves from Squarrel at level 47. Squarrel is found in Blitzwood at roughly levels 40 to 45, and Squashel has no further evolution.
